name: Chatra

evidence.chat: F17: Native online and offline website chat widget on all plans; Free allows five chats a month
evidence.helpdesk: F17: Essential and Pro include an email helpdesk; forward the support email in and answer in Chatra
evidence.inbox: F02: Website chat and messaging with a shared email and social inbox that agents work from

line: Website chat and email messaging with a shared agent inbox.

free.text: Free for 1 agent, limited to 5 chats/month

agents.math: One agent at $31 a month. The free plan is limited to five chats, which is fewer than 100.
Three agents at $31 a month each. 100 conversations fit in the paid chat allowance.
